name: Pizza Shop / Pizzeria
description: A dedicated pizzeria and Italian quick-casual / delivery dining template. Engineered specifically for pizza-centric operations featuring dynamic crust size selection, dough craftsmanship (thin, hand-tossed, deep dish, stuffed, gluten-free), custom topping builders, half-and-half pie partitioning, oven-baked calzones, pastas, appetizers, salads, and value-packed family combo feasts.

sections.name: Classic Pizzas
sections.description: Timeless, traditional oven-baked pizzas featuring house-made slow-simmered tomato sauce, whole-milk shredded mozzarella, and quintessential toppings. This foundational section anchors every pizzeria, providing recognizable favorites that define the shop's core brand, available across standard diameters and crust varieties.

subSections.name: Traditional Favorites
subSections.description: Universally loved crowd-pleasers including classic pepperoni, sausage & mushroom, four-cheese blends, and supreme combinations.

subSections.name: Margherita & Simple Pies
subSections.description: Clean, ingredient-focused artisanal pies highlighting fresh sweet basil, San Marzano tomato fillets, fresh whole-milk fior di latte mozzarella, and extra virgin olive oil.

choices.label: Deep Dish Pan Crust (Thick, buttery caramelized edge)
Stuffed Crust (Ring of molten mozzarella rolled in crust)
Gluten-Free Cauliflower & Rice Crust (Dedicated GF prep)

sections.name: Specialty & Gourmet Pizzas
sections.description: Chef-curated artisan recipes showcasing premium ingredients, complex flavour pairings, alternative sauces, and white pizzas (pizze bianche). This section caters to food lovers seeking culinary elevated experiences beyond standard toppings.

subSections.name: Signature Creations
subSections.description: House-developed hallmark pies combining savory smoked meats, tangy barbecue or fiery hot sauces, and complementary cheeses.

subSections.name: Premium & Gourmet
subSections.description: Upscale pies topped with imported charcuterie like prosciutto di Parma, wild foraged truffle mushrooms, creamy burrata, and fig balsamic reductions.

subSections.name: White Pizzas (Pizze Bianche)
subSections.description: Tomato-free artisan pies highlighting rich ricotta spreads, garlic-infused olive oil bases, fontina, gorgonzola, and aromatic fresh herbs.

choices.label: Deep Dish Pan Crust (Thick, buttery caramelized edge)
Stuffed Crust (Ring of molten mozzarella rolled in crust)
Gluten-Free Cauliflower & Rice Crust (Dedicated GF prep)

sections.name: Build Your Own Pizza
sections.description: Fully customizable pizza canvas giving guests total culinary freedom. Step-by-step guided flow allowing choice of base size, crust dough style, signature sauce, cheese foundation, and segregated or whole toppings, including optional half-and-half partitioned builds.

subSections.name: Custom Crust & Base
subSections.description: Select your foundational dough, crust rim preparation, and whole pie diameter.

subSections.name: Half & Half Combinations
subSections.description: Split pies featuring two distinct recipe configurations across Left and Right halves for sharing without compromise.

subSections.name: Dietary & Alternative Bases
subSections.description: Dedicated gluten-free crusts, keto cauliflower doughs, and dairy-free vegan bases for health-conscious diners.

choices.label: Deep Dish Pan Crust (Thick, buttery caramelized edge)
Stuffed Crust (Ring of molten mozzarella rolled in crust)
Extra Virgin Olive Oil & Crushed Garlic (Bianca)
Italian Four-Cheese Blend (Mozzarella, Provolone, Asiago, Romano)
Fresh Fior di Latte Mozzarella Slices

sections.name: Calzones & Stromboli
sections.description: Folded, stuffed, and golden-baked Italian pocket specialties made from freshly proved pizza dough. Calzones are packed with seasoned whole-milk ricotta and mozzarella, while strombolis are rolled with savoury cured meats and cheeses, served with warm house marinara dipping sauce.

subSections.name: Classic Calzones
subSections.description: Half-moon folded pocket crusts stuffed with creamy ricotta, melted mozzarella, garlic, and Italian herbs, baked until golden blistered.

subSections.name: Stuffed Rolls
subSections.description: Cylinder-rolled pizza dough spirals packed with deli meats, cheeses, peppers, and savory fillings, sliced into shareable portions.

choices.label: Extra Virgin Olive Oil & Sea Salt Flakes

sections.name: Pasta
sections.description: Hearty Italian pasta dishes providing comforting non-pizza entrée alternatives. Features oven-baked pastas topped with bubbling golden mozzarella, as well as sautéed classic pastas tossed in scratch-made sauces like Bolognese, Alfredo, and Marinara.

subSections.name: Baked Pasta
subSections.description: Traditional casserole pastas layered with seasoned cheeses, rich meat or tomato sauces, and baked in pizza ovens until bubbly and caramelized.

subSections.name: Classic Pasta
subSections.description: Freshly boiled pasta extruded or hand-tossed with velvety cream, herb-infused pestos, or slow-cooked plum tomato sauces to order.

sections.name: Appetizers & Starters
sections.description: Flavor-packed finger foods, crispy shareables, freshly rolled garlic breads, and oven-roasted wings. Designed to satisfy pre-meal hunger, facilitate communal sharing around the table, and boost order value for delivery and dine-in groups.

subSections.name: Garlic Breads & Knots
subSections.description: Scratch pizza dough twisted into knots, slathered in minced garlic butter, fresh parsley, and parmesan, alongside toasted cheese-pull loaves.

subSections.name: Wings & Tenders
subSections.description: Jumbo bone-in chicken wings oven-roasted to a crispy finish and golden boneless chicken tenders, tossed in signature sauces.

subSections.name: Dips & Shares
subSections.description: Crisp fried mozzarella sticks, loaded Italian meatballs in skillet marinara, stuffed portobello caps, and artichoke dip platters.

sections.name: Salads
sections.description: Fresh, crisp vegetable and greens courses crafted to cut through the richness of melted cheese and baked dough. Features Italian antipasto bowls, classic caesars, and garden mixes with house vinaigrettes.

subSections.name: House Salads
subSections.description: Everyday garden greens, crisp romaine caesar bowls, and Mediterranean cucumbers and cherry tomato toss-ups.

subSections.name: Specialty Salads
subSections.description: Hearty cured meat antipasto platters, Greek feta salads with kalamata olives, and fresh caprese salads layered with mozzarella and basil.

choices.label: Dressing On the Side (Keeps greens crisp for delivery)

sections.name: Sides
sections.description: Savory accompaniments, hot potato sides, and artisanal oven-baked bread portions designed to pair with pizza pies, pasta dishes, and sandwiches.

subSections.name: Hot Sides
subSections.description: Golden seasoned french fries, loaded pizza fries with marinara and melted mozzarella, and crispy onion rings.

subSections.name: Bread Sides
subSections.description: Cheesy pull-apart garlic bread loaves, focaccia herb triangles, and warm hearth breadsticks.

sections.name: Desserts
sections.description: Sweet finales featuring oven-baked dessert pizzas on warm hearth dough, authentic Italian patisserie staples like crispy cannoli, tiramisu, and gelato, providing high-margin sweet closure to family pizza nights.

subSections.name: Dessert Pizzas
subSections.description: Oven-baked sweet flatbreads smothered with warm hazelnut cocoa spread, marshmallow s'mores, cinnamon streusel, and fresh berries.

subSections.name: Classic Desserts
subSections.description: Scratch-filled crisp Sicilian cannoli with sweet ricotta cream, layered espresso tiramisu, and Italian gelato cups.

sections.name: Beverages
sections.description: Refreshing drinks structured to wash down hot pizza and savory snacks. Essential for delivery operations with party-sized 2-liter soda bottles, chilled single-serve cans, house-made iced teas, and mineral waters.

subSections.name: Soft Drinks
subSections.description: Popular carbonated sodas, cola classics, lemon-lime sodas, and diet beverages available in individual and family sharing delivery sizes.

subSections.name: Fresh Drinks
subSections.description: House-brewed sweet and unsweetened iced teas, fresh-squeezed Italian lemonade, and fruit-infused lemon waters.

subSections.name: Water
subSections.description: Still natural spring waters and sparkling Italian mineral waters in glass and portable bottles.

sections.name: Combo Deals & Family Packs
sections.description: High-value curated bundles packaging pizzas, appetizers, sides, and family beverages together at discounted combo pricing. Drives higher average basket size for group dining, busy weeknight dinners, sporting events, and party gatherings.

subSections.name: Individual Combos
subSections.description: Personal-sized pizza pairings with a side salad or garlic knots and a single beverage, optimized for lunch or single diners.

subSections.name: Family Deals
subSections.description: Multi-pizza packages bundled with large appetizers, dipping sauces, and a 2-liter beverage tailored for 4–6 family members.

subSections.name: Party Packs
subSections.description: High-capacity feasts featuring multiple XL pizzas, bulk wings, shareable bread platters, and multiple sodas for 10+ guests.

systemFeatures.name: Interactive Pizza Builder
systemFeatures.description: Guides customers through an interactive step-by-step dough style, crust sizing, sauce base, cheese blend, and compartmentalized topping customization flow.

systemFeatures.name: Half & Half Pizza Partitioning
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to split recipes and toppings between Left and Right halves on medium, large, and extra-large pizzas, calculating pricing by higher-tier half or combined item additions.

systemFeatures.name: Pizza Size & Slices Selector
systemFeatures.description: Provides intuitive size switching interface showcasing crust diameter in inches, standard slice counts, and estimated guest portion recommendations.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Badging
systemFeatures.description: Displays clear allergen alerts and dietary tags (Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Vegetarian, Vegan, Halal, Nut-Free) across pizza crusts, sauces, and pasta dishes for guest safety.

systemFeatures.name: Real-Time Inventory Badges
systemFeatures.description: Shows real-time item availability statuses such as 'In Stock', 'Sold Out for Today', or 'Dough Batches Low' to prevent orders for unavailable specialty crusts or ingredients.

systemFeatures.name: Spice Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Allows guests to specify spice heat intensity from mild to extra hot on wings, arrabbiata pastas, and spicy specialty pizzas.

systemFeatures.name: Set Menus & Family Packs
systemFeatures.description: Supports multi-item bundled combos, meal deals, and party packages with required selection validation for pizza styles, sides, and beverages.
